name: Canaria-Phase4-California-Housing-regression-stageA-v1
question: Can the unchanged residual-MLP architectural family reach a stable competent validation regime on a substantially larger real regression dataset before any replacement or test evaluation?

parent_boundary.phase3b_result: PHASE3B_CONFIRMATORY_UNCERTAIN: composition and selected utility PASS; stronger-teacher gates UNCERTAIN
parent_boundary.phase3c_result: STOP_NO_STABLE_SAME_ARCHITECTURE_TEACHER on diabetes fixed 13-recipe multi-fold search
parent_boundary.rule: do not expand or weaken diabetes gates; move to a larger dataset as a separate external-validity experiment

dataset.provenance: record array SHA256 and sklearn version at execution; abort if dimensions differ

split.normalization: feature and target mean/std from final Stage-A training subset only; validation transformed with training-only statistics; held-out test not evaluated

architecture: unchanged Phase3 residual MLP family: input->Linear64+GELU->4 residual blocks (LayerNorm, Linear128, GELU, Linear64)->Linear1

numeric_profile.adamw_sqrt_intervention: float32 Tensor.sqrt calls only inside AdamW.step are evaluated in float64 and cast back
numeric_profile.scope: validated research CPU profile; not a universal backend/hardware guarantee

selection_rule.eligible: mean validation R2 across seeds >= 0.65 AND minimum seed validation R2 >= 0.60
selection_rule.winner: among eligible recipes maximize minimum seed validation R2; ties within 1e-12 use higher mean validation R2, lower population std, then earlier fixed recipe order
selection_rule.if_none: STOP_NO_COMPETENT_STABLE_TEACHER; do not evaluate test or fit replacements

future_stage_if_pass: lock a separate replacement/test confirmatory protocol before consuming seed2900; retain matched 256*h component/composed budgets and validation-only endpoint selection
C: The unchanged residual-MLP may fail to reach the competency gate on this dataset.
A competent teacher may later eliminate the composition-budget advantage.
Dataset download/version identity must be recorded; a provenance mismatch stops interpretation.
U: One tabular housing dataset does not establish general regression external validity.
Teacher calibration seeds are not independent datasets.
No runtime, memory, energy or hardware performance inference follows.
stopping_rule: Run exactly 7 recipes x 3 seeds. Persist all21 validation-only rows. Apply the locked selection rule once. No recipe/seed/threshold additions after outcomes; test remains unevaluated regardless of result.
